name: Sidney Johnson Summer Internship at St. Louis County Library
what_you_do: The intern gets a behind-the-scenes look at how a library runs. The intern works at different library branches.
who_can_apply: Students ages 16 to 18 who live in the St. Louis County Library District.
pay_detail: $15.00 per hour, about 12 hours per week
deadline_text: In 2026 applications ran March 1 to March 31 and winners were told by April 30. Dates for summer 2027 are not posted on the program page.
how_to_apply: Watch the program page in March. In 2026 the page had an Apply Now button for the teen internship application.
notes: The 2026 internship ran June 1 to August 7. The intern must be flexible with the schedule and with branches. The intern also writes a final reflection about the summer.
